notes.title: Preview Update #13
notes.content:
Language

It's been a long time since the last update. The main reason for this update is to add a lot of different languages to the game. With the upcoming Update #13 there will be 40 supported languages in the game: 

 Afrikaans
 Arabic
 Basque
 Belarusian
 Bulgarian
 Catalan
 Chinese (Simplified)
 Chinese (Traditional)
 Czech
 Danish
 Dutch
 English
 Estonian
 Finnish
 French
 German
 Greek
 Hebrew
 Hungarian
 Icelandic
 Indonesian
 Italian
 Japanese
 Korean
 Latvian
 Lithuanian
 Norwegian
 Polish
 Portuguese
 Romanian
 Russian
 Serb-Croatian
 Slovak
 Slovenian
 Spanish
 Swedish
 Thai
 Turkish
 Ukrainian
 Vietnamese


However, as I used a translator and I am not capable to spell check all of these languages there will be most certainly errors. So please report them with a screenshot and the correct translation, if you find one. I will correct that as quick as possible.

With the added languages there are also new fonts added to the game to support more characters for special player names for the leaderboard.

Moreover, hints will be resized more strictly to avoid reaching the end of the screen. This will increase the readability for all languages and screen sizes.

Also music titles will not be translated anymore. This means they will keep their original song name.


Music

Speaking of music, I added 8 new music tracks to the game:

 Dandelion
 Hope
 Hopeful
 Light
 Mastered
 New Day
 Silent
 Sunshine


There are now 25 different songs in the game you can choose from. To listen to the new songs you have to activate them on the "Options Cube" under "Audio" and "Music Tracks".


Ambient

I also added 9 new ambient tracks to the game:

 Birds #2
 Branches
 Calm Wind
 Cemetery
 Desert
 Jungle
 Savannah
 Sea Storm
 Tundra


There are now 25 different ambient sounds in the game you can choose from. The same as for the music, to listen to the new ambient sounds you have to activate them on the "Options Cube" under "Audio" and "Ambient Tracks".


Medieval Village Background

Beside that, I also added a new interactable background to the game. With it there are now 25 different backgrounds you can choose from. It's called "Village" and represents a medieval village. You can turn each torch individually on or off with the left mouse button or all at once with the right mouse button. Depending on your lighting and visual effect setting it can achieve different kind of atmospheres:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b30baa831a6e567d928c9d23b715bfd5742a0082.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/2612feae71b65826d642cabb1c03b3e09dd5320b.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b324329c608f40ed9c9530927f49108d1fd0bceb.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/edd3f9f8c62e078cd80f9e578996c1e169514c79.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/2647fb50adbc496e79d1c406ee24b662970c4b94.png


Lighting Moods

Moreover, I added two new lighting moods to the game, which means that there are now also 25 different lighting moods in the game. The first one "Blue Sky" exposes every scene with a bright light and a god-ray effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/c39f2b5525d5a7439993425dcc99a43fbb52f52d.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/ca63f7377df460e00cbcd2e83d9a20a9fa66a3eb.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/9cb10972ac6978a7558051b80ecfce14f0609029.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b61f3d9cc33f7aa771d6065ee7c271864575190a.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/945ddca93f34c73b15ea426131092301675f1bd4.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/711d1c0245e00f2a3c8932b9f122087482b455a3.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/4fa2e2b4f3b1ee4ff9324fbd7e922a7299ab0952.png

The second one "Darkness" does the complete opposite. There are no lights anymore. Use this if you don't like to be distracted or if only the scenery itself should illuminate the scene. Further, "Darkness" lets you embrace the visual effects even more. However, as it makes it very hard to see the matrix blocks and solve any matrix, I recommend to use the self-illuminating "Neon" blocks with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/5a52f23f8438f648aa4f2dc4ff41c0587a8ce65a.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/f15a0c7e4254a01c39d6d36a2517e94a2282cf78.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/09ec9e096dc79d2f1358c8c09c519d8bf859ef0d.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/e771c575fbac1bf8af030e25af32ac9466dcdf23.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/cb6e6fb6f23baad4bac0c0514723b9757b85a547.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/e5b697882dc66c7721505e1256318e173f5fb2fb.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/0b3d63ccf008f6241ddb65d0534637122952c171.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b3f4b6c21faa77ded197580988393d58622859d0.png


Visual Effects

There are also two new visual effects, which brings them also, and you probably guessed it now, to 25 visual effects you can choose from. The first one is called "Meteorite" and it will let rain meteorites from the sky, which will collide with the scene, explode and shatter into small pieces. It is also interactable and you can try to click a meteorite during the flight to let it explode in air. 

Why a meteorite shower in a calm riddle game? You should ask Wyvern-of-the-Rising-Sun as he suggested it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/6d48c413b5caa73c9b5b73b36f10b6fa3e7f4bda.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/415fbefda5a99acfe8f98f5ecd5ca6cd82f74e8f.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/338b7a4a18ecc1a1143c28ad5ecf98fb896c1178.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/74fdc901a6f83e80d2a7171eff39ec79b10e5b1c.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/5a48311960d029619fda961d1d0745c0fb43f8ef.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/04d57282a876159d95c9852479c210719e21b7d5.png

The second visual effect was also suggested by him. A "Dragon" with 7 balls floating around. The dragon and his balls (no pun intended) are interactable and will react to your actions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/692fe8b291250b1342f1294e5ef2b009834daa3b.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/1ec263c99ad184c80036cda25d615448a0c818e1.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b8cb1a85138ae5df50998bc0eea44a0cba1b1bae.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/2888088ad82dc828f82fd35de87a685047f05b37.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/673af93a659b297a46e78c142e69faa2b15526de.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/c226c92be94416b1f4ff7d85261950d2c37262fb.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/f978efe1b2a9f2e682db773044a718917cc07334.png


Block Style

To make everything complete, I also added two new block styles to the game, which brings them to 25 too. Actually, it is one block style with two variants. The block style "Leaf 1" will be without and "Leaf 2" with color and as the name suggested, it shows leaves with different counts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/e57fcc0974fcf5e1230e7205a39f9af85ae3b3aa.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/e5098aefe4872091313d4568e3024b2da003834e.png


These features and also some small performance optimizations will be available with Update #13, which will be released on the 25th September 2022.

notes.title: Preview Update #12 - Release
notes.content:
Release and Demo

With the Update #12, which will be available at Friday 2nd July evening (CET), Matrix Brain Twister will leave Early Access and become a full release. This means the monthly update rhythm will be changed to an update on demand. So only if you or I find still some bugs or have a new idea which features I can add to the game, I will do that as quick as possible.

Moreover, the demo will be updated to the latest version too.

What is in the demo?

random generated or empty 2D and 3D matrices with all different forms
all ambient and button sounds as well as all music tracks
all different cursor, block styles, lighting moods, backgrounds and visual effects

What is NOT part of the demo?

4D matrices
600 handcrafted levels for 2D, 3D and 4D matrices
save/load, achievements, progression, statistics, leaderboard
Steam Workshop content


Steam Workshop

With the release, the Steam Workshop will be go online. This means you can create and upload custom content for "Ambient" and "Button" sounds, "Block Style" and "Cursor" images and also your own "Music".

The specific instructions on how to create custom content can be found at multiple places (in game, custom folder, Steam Workshop, Steam Forum). You can also download "Sample" content from the Steam Workshop to look how it should be done.

Cloudy Lighting Mood

I added a new animated lighting mood called "Cloudy". It is a bright blue background with sun rays from the left and animated clouds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/3b5ac70972389bbad311c5f4abcb3371238019e1.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/d4f9fc17fa3aad62176bb196ca0c1a395150d008.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/bae49841767bf368a78ee83911453559e3c29614.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/0d867ea9b4c58e4192467764fdb81d3883d9ea3f.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/203e906bf16f17a8f3c224112a719b1b4ae2ce83.jpg


Block Styles

Lately I've been neglecting the block style a bit. That's why I have create three new ones.

The first static block style is called "Isometric". It has its origin from optical illusions and looks like a block out of smaller blocks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/bdf41800701fb8b35d901fa478a654a9e29db4ff.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/39c9011919ce44850fa9ea97f523cab53a8df89f.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/a7c5be9703b4e118cb5a9457ac3b7d8e314713d2.jpg

The second static block style is called "Dash". There are two variants of it. One colorless version and one with color. It is helpful for colorblind people or if the set environment has very few lights. This makes it easier to differ color states of blocks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/8dfd5a190c493c10f78463cae8304ba370aa4606.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/c67f573dfff61e86941deaec2231965208e053e4.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/e505372d4cbdf33b1247a5b48a03ea32ecfd5d56.jpg

4D Levels

Last but not least I added 30 new levels and achievements for the 4D Pentachoron 4x4x4x4 matrix.

It starts fairly easy, but gets hard to solve very quick. So I recommend this one only for experienced riddlers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/928f31f14c47a73d605b5d47b3f370ab8fa4e40b.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/d40031ac81c5f49c2b6f79cfd7ccf745285c8ec9.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/fb9af05ec2b2473a8fa7ddf6f15975e83ade49ea.jpg

With the addition of these new levels there are now over 600 handcrafted levels to solve and therefore 1800 stars to collect.


These features will be available with the next and last update before release.

See this short video for an example. The following settings were used:

Visuals

Sounds

[previewyoutube=MIPPnCMPeps;full][/previewyoutube]

It looks like an intimidating 2D matrix, but it is actually easier to solve than the 5x5 Square matrix. Just focus on the first levels and you will solve all others in no time.

notes.title: Preview Update #8
notes.content:
MacOS and Linux

With this update there will be versions for Mac and Linux user.

However, Linux user need to have the Vulkan API installed, otherwise the game will crash. So if you have the Vulkan API properly installed and the game still crashes for your Linux OS, you should refund the game for now.


Back-End Update

I also updated the Unity Editor, its High Defintion Render Pipeline (HDRP) and Steamworks to the latest version. In addition to that I converted the game files from C# to C++ (Windows and Linux). All in all this update has a huge impact on the visuals, especially lighting, and performance.

Therefore, let me know in the Steam Forum, how your favourite scene now looks and performs (better or worse FPS, visual glitches, artifacts, low resolution shadows, etc.).


Volumetric Lighting

Furthermore, due to this back-end update I changed the volumetric lighting effect for all scenes to reduce the low quallity noise. Moving light sources should also flicker less aggressively now.

In the graphic settings there is a new option to change the volumetric lighting quality (Low, Mid, High, Ultra). The performance impact depends on the choosen scene and can be between no (0 FPS) or mediocre (~10 FPS) gain/lost. 


Victorian Background

The already existing victorian background gets three new view directions. So you can now have four different views in one background. Change the view by clicking on the street name sign on the left or right side. As before, all street lights can be turned on/off individual with a left click or all at once with a right click.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/5fb9e3eb4ef8bdc29fed0a4d7b2e4c162e072f38.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/06f258186190165568630aa67487d1390215eb65.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/7e80ae9cbbce503a6d71077d7d88e962ee3c5034.png


Custom Cursor

With Update #6 it is also possible to create your own custom cursor. Just create three 512x512 png files named "Default.png", "Click.png" and "Drag.png". The click point is always in the center of the image. So make sure your cursor is pointing to the center.

Then create a folder in "Matrix Brain Twister/Matrix Brain Twister_Data/StreamingAssets/Custom/Cursor" with a name of your choice and put these png files into it. 

Then start the game and you will see your custom cursor at the style settings on the option cube.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/d8653bcbda7f239db4b99e8a5b64434ea7a75226.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/7e1362bc5126767dbc85d8f0020a4653b8e55fd8.png

I also changed the Sandstorm VFX and made the grains of sand finer. Here is a comparision:

Old
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/d8dd9c568a6da2093febeb19224664b41f294f35.png

New
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/6c2700cfdde2329ac664defbe7b2836a2808daba.png


Style Everywhere

One last new feature is that you can now change the style of the game wherever you are. Just press one of the following buttons to change the assigned style.

C - Cursor
M - Matrix Block
L - Lighting Mood
V - VFX
B - Background



This and as always some few bug fixes will be available with the next update.

notes.title: Update #1 - 23.07.2020
notes.content:
New Features

 new 4D levels for the 4D Hypercube of size 2
 new ghosty lighting mood
 6 different mountain backgrounds; change through them by clicking on the flag
 new water shader; change through them by clicking on the buoy
 every saved matrix has now a small save icon; with this you can faster recognize your saved games


New Requested Features

 no features were requested


Fixed Bugs

 fps counter now more accurate
 small engine optimizations


Fixed Reported Bugs

 no bugs were reported


See the preview event for more details.

notes.title: Preview Update #1
notes.content:
Mountains

I created recently some new backgrounds. You can choose "Mountains" in the style settings and then you can see some grassy and alpine mountains. Also one type of a desert and an african mountain and also two types of nordic mountains. There are 6 different mountains in total. Click on the flag to switch between them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/a4f271698951993dbf2c4c6e610bdcdf2135427e.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/7b2455fe0d2f078a5ddaec3bbeed17758d075629.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/51b34043c5b5a22799ad84fe9448e79e6d26c3ce.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/4f88affa2ebe27f3b6d1335848076154a83a6b75.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b6954d3594849fa9291ce1737408c258f29bba60.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/fa3f9ec1e4390cd4d265c47595a2a6a176e33152.png

Ghost Flame Light

I also experimenting with a new light mood. It should create a ghostly atmosphere in any scenario. The ghost flame flickers in light intensity and also moves randomly around you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/016ad97388ef937a9ca882888fdfef6a9eaba735.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/06c025cc6de41b4fe2a3741f00e9df3f95bc0c5f.png

4D Levels

Moreover, I finally finished the first 30 handcrafted levels for the 4D Hypercube 2x2x2x2 Matrix.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/b8481e99697965346c6cf57af4a691247bdc25e8.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/3f0e983d0405781cf40fbb55462630ad957d5f60.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37545163/0c0410f9d7ef19f19a976c5e299545ba49d73fb6.png


These things and some bug fixes will be available with the next update.
